source: Number codes of the keyword arguments of the Concord helper effects (shared_concord_dominions.md, 'Arguments': charter old 0, golden 1, shield 2, free 3, wall 4; camp court 1, faithful 2, dominions 3, host 4 = the values of zin_aenor_ruling_camp). The Middle Lands tier B trees (regional_c) call zin_concord_petition_charter and zin_concord_back_camp with these keywords. Same shape as focus_arg_codes.json; loadArgCodes reads this file next to it. Remove it when the same prefix is listed in focus_arg_codes.json.
